title: Mee ammayi case lo pattubadindi (romanised Telugu)

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, meeru Sravani gari nanna gaara? Nenu Banjara Hills police station nunchi SI Reddy matladutunnanu.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Mee ammayi drugs party lo pattubadindi. Case file chesthe aame future motham poyinatte.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ee vishayam evvariki cheppakandi, media ki telisthe inka problem. Memu ikkade settle chestham.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ippude ee UPI ki yabhai vela pampandi, ammayi ni vadilestham.
